material.subject: Is --freddie-composer-height read anywhere on the scroll-alignment path (CSS scroll-padding/scroll-margin or JS), and is it set on the same scroller that TrajectoryTable scrolls?
material.witness_evidence: exec_js grep over packages/**: --freddie-composer-height consumed via scroll-padding-block-end on .freddie-conversationRoot__scrollBody (ConversationRoot.css:227, the element that receives the var at ConversationRoot.js:36) and ChatView.css:133, views.css:39 derives --freddie-trajectory-bottom-clearance used only as padding-bottom on .freddie-trajectoryTable__tablePane (TrajectoryTable.css:21); no scroll-padding on the trajectory pane. Dispatch 1793543391324-630-4ad9a152237bea1f and 1793543408843-661-c7b78c17f2e5f2b3 and 1793543395654-639-1594e1d77dd2cc55.
